answer.location_description: Whole image: a horizontal stripe (grating) pattern with a 4-row period. Paired rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21 are set against paired rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, 14-15, 18-19 and 22-23 across the full width, including background lung far from the nodule.
answer.shortcut_type: periodic horizontal stripe / line artifact (image-level texture pattern)
answer.mechanism: Two groups of first-layer units act as opposite-phase stripe detectors. Group B (units 5, 11, 15) has negative biases (-46, -75, -74) and positive weights on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21, with near-zero weights elsewhere. It works as a thresholded detector of brightness on those rows. Group A (units 0, 3, 14, 18, 23, 24, 26, 28) has large positive biases (75-99), positive weights on rows 2-3, 6-7, ... 22-23 and negative weights on rows 0-1, 4-5, .... Group A feeds layer-2 units u6, u7, u9 and u12, which carry negative output weights (-55, -73, -56, -69), so it pushes toward benign. Group A inhibits, and group B excites, layer-2 units u1, u4 and u8, which carry positive output weights (+85, +99, +59). Brightness on the 0-1 mod 4 rows therefore switches off the benign path and switches on the malignant path. The stripe phase in the opposite sense pushes toward benign.
answer.evidence: Unit 5 averages about +40 to +50 on rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21, and about 0 on the other rows. Units 11 and 15 show the same pattern. Unit 0 and its sister units average about +30 to +40 on rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, ... and about -20 to -40 on rows 0-1, 4-5, .... These stripes run the full 24 columns, well outside the nodule. The pattern is a strict 4-row grating, which nodule anatomy would not produce. In layer 2, u4 has weights -60, -90, -49, -90 and -77 from units 0, 14, 18, 24 and 28, and +24, +28, +32 from units 5, 11 and 15. u8 has -72, -86, -71, -81 from units 0, 3, 18 and 26, and +58, +38 from units 11 and 15. u12 has +89, +87, +87 from units 14, 23 and 28. u6 has +99 from unit 28 and +89 from unit 24. The other eight hidden units (1, 2, 4, 6, 7, ...) carry small, unstructured, noise-like weights.
answer.main_feature: Beyond the stripe grating, the structured units carry a modest centre-specific component: negative weights around rows 8-17, columns 8-12 and positive weights around rows 9-11, columns 16-18. This suggests some sensitivity to nodule shape or margin and internal density, but the dominant learned signal is the stripe pattern.
